verdict: A real, connected story, sourced and dated, told in one continuous cel-shaded world. The 12 NOV whip back to the chair (turn_12nov.png), the stamp hit (stamp_MA.png) and the 96 juta to 732 descent show real craft, and t055.82 lands 'Lo nggak termasuk.' cleanly. It is not yet at the house bar. Readability is the weakest criterion: the barrier arm cuts through the ILUSTRASI and MIN. 40 chips at 14-19 s, several chips sit around 38-48 px, and headlines exit as grey ghosts (t018, t026). Truth labelling is muddied by one global ILUSTRASI chip over real KPU figures, and a mid-roll 66.257.343 sits under a real label. The 36-38 s crowd is a flat icon grid that breaks the style and repeats across two samples. The closing number 732 is never shown large. Hook and audio are unproven beyond 7: frame 0 is static, and no human has listened. Average 7.3, below the gate of 8; fix readability first, then truth labels, then the 36-38 s crowd.
